title: Drafter Guided Intake. Speak Business, Not Legalese
note: Guided steps mirroring the SME offer-document structure. Each question is tagged to the disclosure requirement(s) it feeds and bound to a dotted path in the issuer data, so the on-screen coverage score moves as the promoter answers. In the demo, answers are pre-filled from the selected sample issuer so a full run takes under a minute on screen.

steps.title: Eligibility & Standing
steps.help: Before anything is drafted: can this company make an SME IPO at all? These are gate conditions under Chapter IX: they are not disclosures, and no amount of drafting works around them.

questions.label: Was the company converted from a proprietorship, partnership firm or LLP?
questions.help: If it was incorporated as a company from the start, answer No.

questions.label: If converted: has at least one full financial year passed since the conversion?
questions.help: Regulation 229(4). The draft offer document cannot be filed before a full financial year has elapsed post-conversion.

questions.label: In the last year, has there been a complete change of promoter, or have new promoters acquired more than 50% of the shareholding?
questions.help: Regulation 229(5) imposes a one-year wait from the date of the final change.

questions.label: Have you applied to an SME exchange for listing, and chosen a designated stock exchange?
questions.help: Regulation 230(1)(a).

questions.label: Is a depository agreement in place for dematerialisation of your shares?
questions.help: Regulation 230(1)(b). The tripartite agreement with the depository and the registrar.

questions.label: Are all existing partly paid-up equity shares either fully paid up or forfeited?
questions.help: Regulation 230(1)(c). Answer Yes if you have never issued partly paid shares.

questions.label: Are all shares held by the promoters in dematerialised form?
questions.help: Regulation 230(1)(d).

questions.label: Do you have firm, verifiable financing arrangements for 75% of the project cost that the IPO is NOT funding?
questions.help: Regulation 230(1)(e). Excludes the issue proceeds themselves and identifiable internal accruals. Sanction letters count; intent does not.

steps.title: Company Identity
steps.help: The basic identity of your company, exactly as it appears on your Certificate of Incorporation.

questions.label: Registered company name
questions.help: As on the Certificate of Incorporation, including 'Limited'.

questions.label: Corporate Identification Number (CIN)
questions.help: The 21-character CIN issued by the MCA.

questions.label: Date of incorporation
Place of incorporation
Registered office address
Investor contact email
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
questions.help: Name and designation of the person who will handle investor grievances.

questions.label: Main objects (as per your MOA, in plain words)
questions.help: What your Memorandum of Association permits the company to do.

steps.title: Business Overview
steps.help: What your company does, how it makes money, and who its customers are. This feeds 'Our Business' and drives several risk factors.

questions.label: In one paragraph, what does your company make or do?
What are your main products or services?
How do you earn revenue?
Which industry / sector are you in?
In a few sentences, describe your industry and what drives demand
questions.help: Do not quote market-size or growth figures here unless you can cite a public source, those are added by your merchant banker.

questions.label: Total revenue from operations last year (INR crore)
questions.help: This must match your audited financials. Drafter cross-checks it.

questions.label: List your five largest customers and the % of revenue each contributes
Who are your key suppliers, and do any belong to your promoter group?
questions.help: Be candid about promoter-owned suppliers, an undisclosed one is a common cause of exchange objections.

questions.label: Your plants / facilities and their installed capacity and utilisation
Employee strength
Your main competitive strengths
Your growth strategy
Trademarks, patents or designs you own or use, and their registration status
questions.help: If you own none, say so, an express nil statement discharges the disclosure; silence does not.

questions.label: Properties you own or lease, with tenure
questions.help: Owned or leased, where, and on what tenure. Say if any is taken from a promoter or a promoter-connected party.

questions.label: Key performance indicators of your business, for each of the last three years
questions.help: The operating metrics you actually run the business on: order book, capacity utilisation, revenue per site, realisation per unit. These must be certified and approved by your audit committee.

questions.label: What drove the change in your revenue and margins over the last three years?
questions.help: Plain-language reasons, feeds the Management Discussion & Analysis chapter.

steps.title: Financials & Objects of the Issue
steps.help: Upload your audited financials, or key in the summary figures. Then say what the IPO money is for.

questions.label: Upload audited financials (Excel / CSV / PDF)
questions.help: Drafter reads the three-year series and the year headings automatically: revenue, profit, net worth, EPS, RoNW and operating cash flow, and fills the table below. Optional, but it discharges five disclosures at once.

questions.label: Three-year restated financial series
questions.help: An offer document is a three-year document: the restated statements, the capitalisation statement and the weighted-average EPS and RoNW all need the series, not just the latest year. Operating profit also decides eligibility under Regulation 229(6). Upload above to fill this automatically.

questions.label: Latest-year revenue from operations (INR crore)
Latest-year profit after tax (INR crore)
Earnings per share (INR)
Return on net worth (%)
Net asset value per share (INR)
Name of your peer-reviewed statutory auditor
questions.help: Mandatory. A missing auditor reference is one of the three patterns the exchange returns drafts for.

questions.label: Auditor's firm registration number (FRN)
Listed companies comparable to yours, with their key ratios
questions.help: If no directly comparable listed peer exists, say exactly that, it is an accepted disclosure and Drafter will render it as one.

questions.label: What will you use the IPO money for? (purpose + amount in INR crore)
questions.help: The amounts must add up to your net proceeds. Drafter reconciles them.

steps.title: The Issue & Capital Structure
steps.help: The shape of the offering and your share capital before and after it.

questions.label: Type of issue
questions.help: e.g. Fresh issue, fixed price.

questions.label: Face value per share (INR)
Equity shares outstanding before the IPO
New equity shares to be issued in the IPO
Gross issue size (INR crore)
Estimated issue expenses (INR crore)
Net proceeds (INR crore)
questions.help: Gross issue size minus issue expenses. Drafter checks this bridge.

questions.label: Indicative price band per share (INR)
Does the issue include an offer for sale by existing shareholders?
questions.help: Since 8 March 2025 an offer for sale in an SME issue is capped at 20% of the total issue size, and no selling shareholder may offer more than half of their pre-issue holding.

questions.label: Size of the offer for sale component (INR crore)
questions.help: Leave blank if the issue is a fresh issue only.

questions.label: Appointed market maker
Shares reserved for the market maker
questions.help: Mandatory on both SME platforms. This portion is deducted from the issue to arrive at the net issue to the public.

questions.label: Monitoring agency for the deployment of issue proceeds
questions.help: If your issue size does not require one, write that no monitoring agency is required and why.

questions.label: How did you arrive at the working-capital amount you are raising?
questions.help: The assumptions and holding periods you relied on: debtor days, inventory days, creditor days. An unexplained working-capital object is a standard exchange query.

questions.label: Break-up of your estimated issue expenses
questions.help: By category. Drafter checks the total against the issue expenses figure above.

questions.label: History of your equity share capital
questions.help: Every allotment since incorporation: subscription to the MOA, preferential allotments, private placements, bonus and rights issues.

questions.label: Pre-issue shareholding pattern
questions.help: Every shareholder and their category. Drafter reconciles the total against the shares outstanding before the IPO.

steps.title: Management & Governance
steps.help: Your board, key managerial personnel, and any dealings with entities connected to your promoters.

questions.label: Directors and their particulars
questions.help: Name, designation, age and experience of each director.

questions.label: Key managerial personnel (CFO, Company Secretary)
Remuneration paid to directors and key managerial personnel
questions.help: For the last financial year, per person. Include sitting fees paid to independent directors.

questions.label: Related-party transactions (dealings with promoter-owned or group entities)
questions.help: If you buy from, sell to, or lease from a promoter-connected party, say so here. Declaring 'Nil' while describing such a dealing elsewhere is a red flag Drafter catches.

questions.label: Group companies
Subsidiaries, if any
questions.help: Name, holding and financial position of each. If you have none, write that you have none, the express statement is the disclosure.

questions.label: Board committees (Audit, NRC, Stakeholders Relationship)
Name(s) of your promoter(s)
questions.help: As they will appear on the cover page.

questions.label: Promoter particulars (name, age, experience)
Promoter shareholding before the IPO (%)
Weighted average cost of acquisition of your promoters' shares (INR per share)
questions.help: What the promoters actually paid per share on average. It is compared against the issue price, and a wide gap must be explained.

questions.label: Minimum promoter contribution, post-issue (%)
questions.help: The portion of post-issue capital your promoters will hold and lock in.

questions.label: Do you confirm the promoter contribution will be locked in for the prescribed period, and the balance pre-issue capital for the shorter period?
questions.help: Answer 'Not yet confirmed' if this has not been settled with your merchant banker. Drafter will report it as outstanding rather than assume it.

questions.label: Do you confirm that the company, its promoters and its directors are not debarred from accessing the capital markets, and none is a wilful defaulter or a fugitive economic offender?
questions.help: This confirmation is an eligibility condition for the issue itself, not a formality.

steps.title: Legal & Statutory
steps.help: Any pending disputes, tax demands or regulatory matters, and the approvals you hold. Complete disclosure here is what keeps the draft clean.

questions.label: Pending litigation against the company, its directors or promoters
questions.help: Include tax demands and regulatory notices. If a matter is mentioned anywhere in your answers, it must appear here. Drafter cross-checks.

questions.label: Has your statutory auditor issued the statement of special tax benefits available to the company and its shareholders?
questions.help: A separate certificate from your auditor. It is a mandatory annexure, and it is commonly left until the end.

questions.label: Outstanding direct and indirect tax matters
Material developments since your last audited accounts
Key regulatory approvals and licences held
Approvals applied for or still required

steps.title: Indebtedness & Dividend
steps.help: Your borrowings and your dividend record.

questions.label: Total borrowings (INR crore)
Principal lenders and the security you have given them
Material terms of your borrowings (interest, tenor, covenants)
Your dividend policy
Dividends declared in the last three years

steps.title: Issue Structure & Intermediaries
steps.help: The intermediaries you have appointed. These appear on the cover page.

questions.label: Lead manager / merchant banker
Registrar to the issue
Underwriter
Banker to the issue
Legal advisor to the issue
Listing platform
questions.help: NSE Emerge or BSE SME.

questions.label: Price information of past issues handled by your lead manager
questions.help: Your lead manager supplies this, the issues they have handled and how those shares have traded since listing. Ask them for it early; it is a common late item.
